text:
Sam Chen: Quick sync — proposing a small UX change to console saved queries: auto-apply pinned model per-route and surface a 'quota preview' in the save modal. Thoughts?
Lia Patel: I like the idea. We already show per-route defaults in the inspector, but auto-applying a model pin could be surprising. Maybe an explicit checkbox 'apply route default' instead of forced override. :thinking:
Mohit Desai: Agree with Lia. Also we need the backend shape — do we store route-scoped saved queries or attach a route binding meta field?
Sam Chen: Proposal: saved_query has optional fields: scope: ["global"|"route:/<id>"], model_pin (optional), and quota_preview boolean. UI: if scope is route, precheck 'apply route default' and show a tooltip.
Kelly Wu: UX nit: show estimated token burn in the modal based on recent telemetry sample. Users often save queries without realizing cost. We can show a small line: "Est. token burn per run: 1.2k tokens (~$0.03)"
Rosa (pm): Important: telemetry + privacy — if we compute cost estimates from sampled requests, we must surface sampling and opt-out in the modal. Also need to decide sampling rate; current telemetry sample is 1% for route queries.
Mohit Desai: For API contract, something like: 
```
POST /api/saved_queries
{
  "name": "errors-route-presets",
  "scope": "route:/errors",
  "model_pin": "redwood/text-2.0-q4",
  "quota_preview": true
}
```
Should be backward compatible if scope omitted (defaults to global).
Lia Patel: Rollout plan: canary the UI to 10% of orgs, then 50% after we validate telemetry. Also add an entry in Console > Insights to surface 'saved queries with route pins' so we can spot odd patterns.
Sam Chen: Agree. Mohit, can backend add a flag in the saved_query audit trail when the preview estimate was present and which sample window was used? We need that for debugging pricing complaints.
Mohit Desai: Yep — I can add metadata keys: preview_sample_window and preview_sample_rate. They won't be required fields.
Kelly Wu: Minor: show a little info icon linking to explanation: "How we estimate tokens" -> docs link. Also, if model_pin conflicts with user-per-route pin, show a conflict affordance instead of silently overriding.
Rosa (pm): Governance question: who can create route-scoped saved queries? I think route owners + admins. We should check ACL surface.
Sam Chen: Agree on ACL. Implementation checklist: 1) API shape + backward compatibility (Mohit) 2) Save modal UI changes + quota preview (Lia/Kelly) 3) Telemetry sampling transparency & audit fields (Mohit/Rosa) 4) Canary rollout config + telemetry dashboards (Rosa/Sam)
deploy-bot: canary-rollout created: saved-query-route-pin-v1 -> 10% -> started
Lia Patel: I'll draft the modal copy and add the tooltip content. Will send a screenshot tomorrow. :thumbsup:
Mohit Desai: I'll open a PR for API changes with migration notes. Targeting review by EOD Wed.
Sam Chen: Cool — thanks. Quick follow-up: let's include a small experiment to compare token estimate vs actual for a 2-week window so we can calibrate. Add to the checklist?
Rosa (pm): Added. 
Kelly Wu: SGTM.
Sam Chen: Thanks everyone, closing for now.
